# Backspace Fork 1.16.6

## Juno: hammer reports and steadier feedback

- Restored the rounded green/cyan lobby and results buttons.
- Replaced the report flag and visible countdown with the approved transparent
  hammer, with its striking base centered over the player's avatar.
- Confirmed reports now play a short hammer strike, glow and particles at the
  accused seat, without flying cards or a large overlay over the draw/discard piles.
- Cards stay visible and the table stays stationary during reports and after
  effects finish. Short, narrow and scaled views retain reachable controls.
- Target-specific accessible labels, keyboard controls and reduced-motion support
  remain available. The ten-second report deadline, two-card penalty, game rules,
  permissions, federation and scoring are unchanged.

No database migration or operator configuration change is required. Active games
are ephemeral and may need a new round when the application server restarts.
